title: Never Say THIS in NYC Cafes: Ordering & Tipping (Order Like a Local)

subtitles.en:
Hello everyone! Welcome back to the AB
English Podcast... I'm Mia!
subtitles.zh: 大家好！歡迎回到 AB 英語播客……我是 Mia！

subtitles.en:
And I'm Alex. Well, it is really great to
have you with us today!
subtitles.zh: 我是 Alex。嗯，今天能有大家陪伴真的太棒了！

subtitles.en:
Alex, tell me... have you ever felt
completely terrified at a restaurant abroad?
subtitles.zh: Alex，跟我說說……你曾在國外的餐廳裡感到徹底嚇破膽過嗎？

subtitles.en:
Terrified? Wait, why? Did they... serve
something scary?
subtitles.zh: 嚇破膽？等等，為什麼？難道他們……端上了什麼可怕的東西嗎？

subtitles.en:
No! The first time I ordered steak, the
waiter asked me... how I liked it done.
subtitles.zh: 才不是！我第一次點牛排的時候，服務生問我……想要幾分熟。

subtitles.en: And... what did you say?
subtitles.zh: 那……妳當時是怎麼回答的？

subtitles.en:
Well, I smiled and said... very well, thank
you!
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我笑了笑然後說……非常好，謝謝你！

subtitles.en:
You said very well? Like... well-done, or
doing well?!
subtitles.zh: 妳說非常好？像是……全熟，還是妳過得很好？！

subtitles.en:
Oh, I thought he was asking how I was doing!
He looked... so utterly confused.
subtitles.zh: 噢，我還以為他是在問我過得好不好！他看起來……一臉茫然。

subtitles.en:
That is classic! Wow, ordering food in
English can really feel like a minefield.
subtitles.zh: 這真是太經典了！哇，用英文點餐有時候感覺真的像踩地雷一樣。

subtitles.en:
And please... do not get me started on
tipping. That tablet screen gives me so much
anxiety!
subtitles.zh: 還有拜託……別跟我提小費了。那個平板螢幕真的讓我焦慮到不行！

subtitles.en:
Well, today, we will fix all of that! You
will learn simple phrases... and avoid those
awkward cultural mistakes.
subtitles.zh:
好啦，今天我們就要解決這一切！你將會學會簡單的常用句……避開那些令人尷
尬的文化誤區。

subtitles.en:
Awesome! So, Alex, what is the very first
phrase I need?
subtitles.zh: 太棒了！那 Alex，我最需要學的第一句話是什麼？

subtitles.en:
Well, first... stop saying 'I want this' or
'I want that'.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，首先……別再一直說「我要這個」或「我要那個」了。

subtitles.en: Oh? Is saying 'I want' considered rude?
subtitles.zh: 噢？說「我想要」會被認為很不禮貌嗎？

subtitles.en:
Hmm, it sounds a bit like a demand. Instead,
just use: 'Can I get', or 'Could we get'.
subtitles.zh:
嗯……聽起來有點像在命令人。相反地，只要改用：「可以給我」或「我們能要
」就可以了。

subtitles.en:
Ah, like... 'Can I get a latte', or 'Could we
get a table for two'?
subtitles.zh: 啊，就像……「可以給我一杯拿鐵」，或是「可以給我們兩人位嗎」？

subtitles.en:
Exactly! It sounds super natural... and very
polite.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！聽起來超級自然……而且非常有禮貌。

subtitles.en:
What about customized orders? Oh, I really
hate soggy salads!
subtitles.zh: 那客製化點餐呢？噢，我真的很討厭泡得軟爛的沙拉！

subtitles.en:
Just say: 'on the side'. For example...
'dressing on the side'.
subtitles.zh: 只要說：「分開放」。例如……「醬料請分開放」。

subtitles.en:
'Dressing on the side'! Wow, that is so
useful for sauces and fries, too!
subtitles.zh: 「醬料分開放」！哇，這在點沾醬或薯條時也超級實用！

subtitles.en:
And when the meal is over, you need two magic
words: 'check', and 'gratuity'.
subtitles.zh: 而在用餐結束時，你需要這兩個神奇字詞：「買單帳單」和「服務費小費」。

subtitles.en:
Hmm, 'check' means the bill, right? But...
what exactly is 'gratuity'?
subtitles.zh: 嗯……買單是指帳單對吧？但是……服務費小費究竟是什麼意思呢？

subtitles.en:
Gratuity is just the formal word for tip or
service charge on your receipt.
subtitles.zh: 那其實就是收據上小費或服務費的正式說法。

subtitles.en:
Let's try a quick roleplay! Pretend... well,
pretend I'm your server at a New York cafe.
subtitles.zh: 我們來快速角色扮演一下吧！想像一下……嗯，假裝我是紐約咖啡館的服務生。

subtitles.en:
Okay, challenge accepted! Let me sit down
first...
subtitles.zh: 好，接受挑戰！先讓我坐好……

subtitles.en:
Hi there! Are you ready to order, or... do
you need another minute?
subtitles.zh: 您好！請問準備好點餐了嗎，還是……需要再稍等一會兒呢？

subtitles.en:
Hi! Can I get the grilled chicken burger,
please?
subtitles.zh: 嗨！可以給我一份烤雞漢堡嗎，謝謝？

subtitles.en:
Sure thing! Would you like fries, or a garden
salad with that?
subtitles.zh: 沒問題！附餐您想要薯條，還是田園沙拉呢？

subtitles.en:
I'll take the garden salad... with dressing
on the side.
subtitles.zh: 我要田園沙拉……醬料請幫我分開放。

subtitles.en:
You got it. And... something to drink for
you?
subtitles.zh: 沒問題。那……需要喝點什麼嗎？

subtitles.en: Just a glass of tap water with ice, please!
subtitles.zh: 請給我一杯加冰塊的一般飲用水就好，謝謝！

subtitles.en: Coming right up!
subtitles.zh: 馬上為您送上！

subtitles.en:
Wow, see? No awkward pausing... and no
sweating!
subtitles.zh: 哇，看到了嗎？完全沒有尷尬卡詞……也沒有冒冷汗！

subtitles.en:
Perfect ordering! And well, asking for tap
water is completely normal in the US.
subtitles.zh: 點得太完美了！而且呢，在美國要求喝一般自來飲用水是完全正常的。

subtitles.en:
Yes! In many places, tap water is free... so
you don't have to buy expensive bottled
water.
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！在很多地方，飲用水都是免費的……所以根本不必買昂貴的瓶裝水。

subtitles.en:
Now, Alex... let's talk about the elephant in
the room: tipping!
subtitles.zh: 現在，Alex……我們來聊聊大家最不敢直說的核心話題：給小費！

subtitles.en:
Oh, tipping rules... they confuse almost
every single traveler.
subtitles.zh: 噢，小費的規則……幾乎讓每一位旅客都感到暈頭轉向。

subtitles.en: But why do Americans care so much about tips?
subtitles.zh: 但為什麼美國人會這麼在乎小費呢？

subtitles.en:
Well, in the US, servers earn a very low
hourly base wage... Tips are actually their
main living income.
subtitles.zh:
嗯，在美國，服務生的基本時薪非常低……小費其實是他們維持生計的主要收入
來源。

subtitles.en:
So... well, how much should we actually tip
at a sit-down restaurant?
subtitles.zh: 那...在坐下來用餐的正式餐廳，我們到底該給多少小費呢？

subtitles.en:
Hmm, standard is usually eighteen to twenty
percent. But—for outstanding service—twenty-
two percent or even more!
subtitles.zh:
嗯，一般標準通常是百分之十八到二十。但要是服務特別好，
甚至可以給到百分之二十二以上喔！

subtitles.en:
Oh, but what about that iPad checkout screen
at coffee shops? Wow, that always makes me
panic!
subtitles.zh: 噢，但咖啡店結帳時轉過來的平板畫面呢？哇，那每次都讓我慌到不行！

subtitles.en:
Well, don't panic! Look—if you're standing up
and taking your food to go... tipping is
totally optional.
subtitles.zh: 哎，別慌啦！你看，如果你是站著點外帶，給小費完全是隨意自願的。

subtitles.en:
Really? So... I can just press "No Tip"
without feeling guilty?
subtitles.zh: 真的嗎？所以我可以直接按「不給小費」，完全不用覺得心虛囉？

subtitles.en:
Absolutely! Believe me... no one will judge
you for skipping tips on takeout.
subtitles.zh: 當然！相信我，外帶不給小費，絕對沒有人會對你指指點點的。

subtitles.en:
Hmm, what about Europe? Do they have the
exact same tipping culture?
subtitles.zh: 嗯，那歐洲呢？那邊也是一模一樣的小費文化嗎？

subtitles.en:
Oh, no, Europe is completely different! In
countries like France and Italy... service is
almost always included in the bill.
subtitles.zh:
噢，完全不是，歐洲非常不一樣！在法國和義大利這些國家，
服務費幾乎都已經包含在帳單裡了。

subtitles.en:
Wow... so you really don't need to add
another twenty percent?
subtitles.zh: 哇...所以真的完全不需要再外加百分之二十囉？

subtitles.en:
Not at all! People usually just round up the
bill. For example—twenty-eight euros simply
becomes thirty euros.
subtitles.zh:
一點都不用！大家通常只是把金額湊成整數。例如二十八歐元，
就直接湊成三十歐元。

subtitles.en:
Oh, that is so simple! But wait... what about
Japan?
subtitles.zh: 噢，那也太省事了吧！不過等等...那日本呢？

subtitles.en:
Whatever you do, never tip in Japan! If you
leave cash on the table... the waiter will
literally run after you into the street to
return your money!
subtitles.zh:
無論如何，在日本千萬別給小費！如果你在桌上留下現金，
服務生真的會一路衝到大街上追著把錢還給你！

subtitles.en:
Running after you into the street? Oh, wow...
that would be so funny!
subtitles.zh: 追到大街上？天啊，那畫面光想就太好笑了吧！

subtitles.en:
Well, you see, in Japan... great hospitality
is already built right into their pride and
culture.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，其實在日本，極致的待客之道早就深植在他們的自豪感與文化之中了。

subtitles.en:
Hmm, that is really good to know! Now...
let's practice asking for the bill.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，知道這點真讓人安心！現在...我們來練習怎麼向店員要帳單吧。

subtitles.en:
Alright, Mia—how do you ask for the bill
politely?
subtitles.zh: 好，Mia，你會怎麼有禮貌地向對方索取帳單呢？

subtitles.en: Could we get the check, please?
subtitles.zh: 能麻煩幫我們買單嗎？

subtitles.en:
Here is your check! Now... always look
closely before you write down a tip.
subtitles.zh: 這是您的帳單！現在，在寫下小費金額前，請一定要看仔細。

subtitles.en: Wait, why? What exactly should I check?
subtitles.zh: 等等，為什麼？我到底該檢查什麼呢？

subtitles.en:
Well, look for the words "Gratuity" or
"Service Charge." Sometimes... restaurants
include it automatically!
subtitles.zh:
嗯，仔細找找看有沒有「小費」或「服務費」這些字眼。
有時候餐廳會自動直接加進去！

subtitles.en:
Oh! So if it already says eighteen percent
gratuity... I don't need to add another tip?
subtitles.zh: 噢！所以如果上面已經列了百分之十八的小費，我就不用額外再給一次囉？

subtitles.en:
Exactly! Otherwise... well, you'd basically
be tipping twice!
subtitles.zh: 沒錯！不然的話，你基本上等於給了兩次小費！

subtitles.en: Hmm, can we also ask to pay separately?
subtitles.zh: 嗯，那我們也可以要求各自分開付帳嗎？

subtitles.en:
Yes, absolutely! Just say: "Could we split
the check?" or... "Can we pay separately?"
subtitles.zh:
當然可以！只要說：「可以幫我們分開算嗎？」或者「我們可以分開結帳嗎？
」就行了。

subtitles.en:
Alright, let's do some rapid-fire speaking
practice!
subtitles.zh: 太好了，我們現在就來進行一輪快節奏的口說練習吧！

subtitles.en:
Ready? Repeat after Mia. Sentence number
one—"Can I get a table for two, please?"
subtitles.zh:
準備好了嗎？跟著 Mia 一起唸。第一句：「可以給我們兩位的位置嗎，
謝謝？」

subtitles.en: Can I get a table for two, please?
subtitles.zh: 可以給我們兩位的位置嗎，謝謝？

subtitles.en:
Great! Sentence number two—"Dressing on the
side, please."
subtitles.zh: 太棒了！第二句：「醬料請幫我放旁邊，謝謝。」

subtitles.en: Dressing on the side, please.
subtitles.zh: 醬料請幫我放旁邊，謝謝。

subtitles.en:
Nice! Sentence number three—"Could we get the
check, please?"
subtitles.zh: 很好！第三句：「能麻煩幫我們買單嗎？」

subtitles.en: Could we get the check, please?
subtitles.zh: 能麻煩幫我們買單嗎？

subtitles.en:
And the final test—"Is gratuity already
included?"
subtitles.zh: 最後的挑戰題：「小費已經包含在裡面了嗎？」

subtitles.en: Is gratuity already included?
subtitles.zh: 小費已經包含在裡面了嗎？

subtitles.en:
Awesome job! Wow, you're now completely ready
to dine anywhere in the world!
subtitles.zh: 做得太出色了！哇，你現在完全有實力在世界各地的餐廳自信點餐了！

subtitles.en:
That was so fun and useful! Oh man... I will
never say "very well" to my steak again!
subtitles.zh: 這真的太好玩又實用了！天啊，我再也不會把牛排熟度回答成「非常好了」！

subtitles.en:
Exactly. Remember, language isn't just about
words—it's about understanding culture and
feeling confident!
subtitles.zh: 沒錯。記住，語言不單單只是死記單字，更在於理解背後的文化並自信開口！

subtitles.en:
If you want to practice speaking these lines
out loud... definitely go check out GugoPro!
subtitles.zh: 如果大家想親自開口練習這些句子，一定要去體驗看看 GugoPro！

subtitles.en:
Yes! Use the free L-Player to practice
listening line-by-line... and talk directly
to our AI speaking tutor!
subtitles.zh:
沒錯！利用免費的 L-Player 進行逐句精聽跟讀，
還能直接與我們的智慧口說導師即時對話！

subtitles.en:
The links are right in the channel bio and
video description—and both are completely
free!
subtitles.zh: 相關連結都在頻道主頁簡介和影片說明欄裡，而且兩者都完全免費喔！

subtitles.en:
Well, if you learned something new today, hit
that like button and subscribe to the AB
English Podcast!
subtitles.zh:
如果大家今天收穫了新知識，別忘了按讚並訂閱 AB English Po
dcast！

subtitles.en:
Be sure to share this with a friend who's
traveling soon... and hey, leave a comment
telling us your funniest dining mistake!
subtitles.zh:
記得把這集分享給最近要出國的朋友……還有，
一定要在底下留言跟我們分享你最搞笑的點餐糗事喔！

subtitles.en:
Well, thank you so much for listening... and
we'll see you next time!
subtitles.zh: 好啦，非常感謝大家的收聽……我們下次見囉！

subtitles.en: Bye, everyone!
subtitles.zh: 大家掰掰！
